text: Improving road safety across Davenport remains one of my top priorities. I often hear from residents and vulnerable road users regarding speeding drivers on several collector roads throughout our neighbourhoods. While these streets are classified as collector roads, they function more like local streets, connecting residents to many nearby schools, parks, and other everyday destinations. These streets and the neighbourhoods that surround them are used by hundreds of pedestrians, and include existing infrastructure designed to support safer travel. As neighbourhoods in our city continue to grow and more people choose to walk, cycle, and use transit to reach nearby locations, higher vehicle speeds are creating safety risks that affect access to important community spaces.
